title: The nuclear age
summary: The world's first nuclear explosion took place on July 16, 1945, at the Trinity site in New Mexico, and the United States bombed Hiroshima that August. The Soviet Union tested a bomb in 1949, then Britain, France, China, India, Pakistan and North Korea, eight nations in all to test openly. Four decades of enormously expensive arms race followed the war. The Non-Proliferation Treaty, in force from 1970, has been joined by 191 states.

related.because: The Manhattan Project developed and produced the first atomic weapons whose detonation launched the nuclear age.
